faq.a: Kamariah is associated with the Arabic form قَمَرِيَّة, whose core sense is kamariah; lunar, moon-like (feminine) (malay form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Kamariah?
faq.a: Kamariah is associated with Arabic. Kamariah is the Malay form of Arabic قَمَرِيَّة (Qamariyya), the feminine relative form of قَمَر, meaning 'lunar, moon-like'.
Yes — the underlying form قَمَرِيَّة is Arabic.
Kamariah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Kamariah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Qamariyya is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Kamariah mean in Urdu?

faq.q: What does Kamariah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Kamariah is rendered قمریه and carries the sense قمریه، ماه‌سان.
A romanized syllable approximation is ka-ma-riah. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Kamariah, kamariah. Script forms are قمريه, قمریه, قمریہ, قَمَرِيَّة, क़मरिया.
